audits.cleanReason: Swept every not / n't / no / never / nobody / nothing / none / neither / without / rather than / instead / only / just / than construction in v2-r4.md (about 75 hits). Most are plain negative facts or measurements with no contrast pivot (L7 'no higher than a man's chest', L69 'could not see whether that mark was for them', L348 'no good for reading') and are not candidates. The 21 contrast-shaped or pivot-adjacent lines all hold a closed-list keep condition. There are four imperatives (Step 1: L127, L191, L442, L446). Five are binary diagnostics that change what characters do (L105 damp vs bread line, L121 false brawling charge that drives Havel's later witness plan, L125/L129 'It isn't four yards', L241 Havel steering off Tenter Row, L277 'nothing to hide, or had somebody else to do his looking', which makes her look up). Three are hard constraints (L209 'I won't know who put it there', L458 'tag won't open it, but'). Three give spatial precision (L91 'rather than the chair' corrects the 'sat back down' reading, L299 no-cover inventory that forces the climb, L319 'no mask at all' / 'no nearer the sacks', the two-layer plot fact). The rest are POV self-argument with an undercut (L25 nib, L159 chalked wall, L333 'would not stand at the window... Unless he had been taught', L404 'no better reason to doubt him than'). Narration has no 'Not X. Y.' fragment pivot, no source-swap, no count reset and no triple chain toward a noun. No page clusters. On the self-check: every KEEP loses a concrete fact or a plot-driving distinction if deleted. The 100% keep rate reflects four slophunter iterations of negation removal; it is not leniency. Each KEEP is defended in slop-gate-scratchpad-r4a.md.

findings.pattern: P10 / second-sweep: inanimate sound given pursuit verb
findings.text: The staff knocked on the cobbles, the knock following the three of them up the street under the noise of the wheels.
findings.subject: the knock
findings.realAgent: Jaina planting the staff as she walks. The sound travels with the three of them, so it cannot follow them.
findings.reason: An abstract noun (a sound) gets a pursuit verb. The image contradicts itself, because the knock is made by one of the three it is said to follow. The staff striking the cobbles is the literal source, and it is already the subject of the first clause.
findings.suggestedFix: The staff knocked on the cobbles all the way up the street, under the noise of the wheels.
findings.fixNote: The staff stays the subject of a literal strike verb. The three walkers are already named in the two sentences before it.

findings.pattern: P10 receiver noun (city) doing the human work
findings.text: The whole city breathed this stuff and ate it baked.
findings.subject: the whole city
findings.realAgent: The people of Andorhal: the hoist men, the gate guard, and every household on the bread line.
findings.reason: Pattern 10. The city gets the bodily verbs that belong to its people, and those people are inferred rather than visible in the scene. Putting the people back in subject position keeps the meaning.
findings.suggestedFix: Everyone in Andorhal breathed the dust and ate the grain baked.
findings.fixNote: The fix also replaces the vague pointer 'this stuff' with the two referents the paragraph already established (the dust the hoist men worked in, the grain on the guard's spike), so pass B has nothing new to catch.
